text: The accepted event and task drop handlers construct CalEvent or CalTodo, await calendarItemFromMessage, and then open the corresponding editor. Conversion uses the header subject and mid: message ID, defaults dates/alarms and reads message text through a stream listener. Its stop handler tolerates a failed status only when it already has content. This describes the checked helper; not every dropped format or message-stream failure was tested. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Calendar message drops share one asynchronous conversion boundary
